entries.subject: codex-readable-roots-unsupported
entries.claim: per-path readable roots are not expressible in the Codex CLI 0.146.0 app-server protocol
supportingEvidence: generated bindings for CLI 0.146.0 define SandboxPolicy without any readable-root, access or readOnlyAccess field
the readOnly variant carries only networkAccess; only workspaceWrite carries roots, and those are writable
an externalSandbox variant exists and is the only place an external enforcement mechanism could attach
entries.ownerDecision: Public-alpha blocker. Codex read isolation needs an externally enforced sandbox or another verified protocol. The readable-root list Bachata computes is currently inert for this CLI version.

supersessionHistory.reason: recorded as unverified because codex debug exposed no sandbox entry point
generated protocol bindings show the capability does not exist, so it was never a verification gap

entries.subject: codex-wire-compatibility
entries.claim: Bachata's Codex app-server integration is incompatible with Codex CLI 0.146.0 in two ways: kebab-case enums are sent camelCase, and the turn sandbox policy carries a readable-root shape the protocol does not define
supportingEvidence: live turn refused: unknown variant `onRequest`, expected one of `untrusted`, `on-request`, `granular`, `never`
live turn refused: unknown variant `readOnly`, expected one of `read-only`, `workspace-write`, `danger-full-access`
codex app-server generate-ts --out <dir> --experimental, CLI 0.146.0: AskForApproval is untrusted | on-request | granular | never; SandboxMode is read-only | workspace-write | danger-full-access

same bindings: SandboxPolicy is dangerFullAccess | readOnly{networkAccess} | externalSandbox{networkAccess} | workspaceWrite{writableRoots, networkAccess, excludeTmpdirEnvVar, excludeSlashTmp}; there is no readableRoots, access or readOnlyAccess field
src/adapters/codexAppServer.ts:341 sends readOnlyAccess and :349 sends access; the readOnly variant also omits the required networkAccess field
mock-based tests pass because the fixture accepts any variant

tests/readExclusion.test.cjs records the mismatch directly: the readOnly payload carries an access field the protocol does not define and omits the networkAccess it requires, thread/start sends readOnly where SandboxMode expects read-only, and turn/start sends onRequest where AskForApproval expects on-request
entries.ownerDecision: Two separate decisions: the enum serialization is a straight fix once a supported Codex version range is chosen; the readable-root shape has no equivalent in this protocol and needs a different mechanism.

entries.subject: disclosure-accuracy
entries.claim: the outbound disclosure carried four further inaccuracies after the first rewrite
supportingEvidence: role assignments were read from a final map rather than sequentially, so a reassigned or disabled assignRoles step produced the wrong participant permission
aggregate run writablePaths were described as one participant's bounded roots
credentials were said never to leave the machine, which is false for remote provider authentication
provider configuration was implied to be listed in the manifest when only attachments are
entries.ownerDecision: Fixed. Disclosure now walks steps in order, states write capability without claiming per-participant roots, and describes credential handling in terms of what Bachata does with them.
